watches.name: Mystery Box : Forget Time
watches.description: Project background An Artistic Collaboration Between Fiona Krüger and Denis Flageollet. Inspired by physicist Carlo Rovelli’s exploration of the impermanence of time, Mystery Box: Forget Time is a unique mechanical creation that blends art and horology. Conceived by Fiona Krüger and brought to life with Denis Flageollet, this piece invites a new perception of time through both visual and mechanical experiences. This immersive work of art is not just a horological piece, but a poetic reflection on the essence of time, merging art, mechanics, and philosophy. Concept & Design: Fiona Krüger Mechanical Development & Realisation: Manufacture De Bethune and Hawthorn Fine Boxes Technical details Mechanical object with marquetry outer box and internal clock Central opening button and suspended mother of pearl winding key Dimensions : 192 x 192 x 192 mm (Closed) | 192 x 192 x 280 mm (Open) (length x width x height), approx 4.5kgs Internal clock powered by FK:DF:MBT mechanical movement with 7 day power reserve Multi-layered mechanism with a mix of hand finishings and mother of pearl inserts Floating Hour/Minute indication on glass cylinders Edition size & Launch Limited edition of 20 pieces, 2025 Shipping Orders processed within 48 hours, EX weekends and public holidays. This object is available to pre-order, with delivery of pieces starting in November 2025. For further details on delivery times and updates on the manufacturing of your piece please contact us directly at info@fionakruger.com.

watches.name: FK: TASAKI – Entropy I (MOP Lines)
watches.description: Project background FIONA KRÜGER: TASAKI Collaboration. A re-interpretation of Fiona Krüger’s Chaos collection for renowned Japanese Fine Jewellery Maison, TASAKI. The Mother of Pearl dial is punctuated with a graphic "ray" line print, emanating from the gear train. The pattern creates a dynamic play with light on the surface of the dial, while the skeleton design reveals the beautifully decorated CHAOS movement. Technical details Dimensions: 48 x 40 mm (length x width), 8.1 mm thick Mechanical manual wind watch FK "CHAOS" movement in black and silver two-tone colouring Titanium case with brushed and polished hand-finishing Mother of pearl dial with openwork and black line décalque motif Hand-polished indices Edition size & Launch Limited production per annum, 2021

watches.name: Fracture (FK: Perpétuel)
watches.description: Project background Exclusive watch edition for Perpétuel Gellery, Dubai. Fracture stems from Krüger’s exploration of order and chaos and their connection to our perception of time. Inspired in part by the striking rock formations observed during Krüger's frequent visits to Switzerland, Fracture is a visual representation of time — a moment of chaos etched onto our landscape, simultaneously dynamic and static. FRACTURE — Where time has left its mark. Technical details Dimensions: 48 x 40 mm (length x width), 8.1 mm thick Mechanical manual wind watch FK "CHAOS" movement with bespoke two-tone colouring in green & copper Titanium case with brushed and polished finishing Multi-part sun-brushed dial with hand-polished fracture Floating indices Edition size & Launch Limited edition of 7 pieces, 2023 Shipping Orders processed within 48 hours, EX weekends and public holidays.

watches.name: Vanitas Jade (Unique Piece)
watches.description: Project background The Skull is the ultimate symbol of life, death and human experience — as such it has played a key role in both Horological History and Art History. Vanitas is a name given to still life artwork, popular in the 1600’s, which includes various symbolic objects to remind the viewer of their own mortality. VANITAS is a mechanical artwork, a modern day expression of the transience of life. Technical details Dimensions: 306 x 220 mm (length x width), 86 mm thick, approx 5kgs Mechanical manual wind wall clock Powered by L'EPEE in-house movement with a 35 day power reserve Black anodised aluminium skull housing Multi-part skull-shaped mechanism with hand-polishing and hand-painted decor "yawning" power reserve indicator (Closed mouth: full power reserve, Open mouth: empty power reserve) Hand-painted skull shaped bridges Edition size & Launch Unique Piece, 2022 Shipping Orders processed within 48 hours, EX weekends and public holidays. This product has an additional production lead-time of 3 weeks, EX public holidays and industry closures. Shipping details will be confirmed following order confirmation.

watches.name: Entropy I, Purple Pow
watches.description: Project background An explosion is a visual depiction of time — an instant of chaos. It is the embodiment of entropy, a key concept in the laws of thermodynamics which explains that everything goes from order towards disorder ie: that time is directional, that it moves forward. "Chaos is the opposite of Swiss watchmaking, synonymous with perfection and control, and yet they are both representations of time itself. Two sides of the same coin. I thought that contradiction was rather beautiful." ENTROPY I "Purple Pow" — Time is chaos Technical details Dimensions: 48 x 40 mm (length x width), 8.1 mm thick Mechanical manual wind watch FK "CHAOS" movement in black and gold two-tone colouring Titanium case with brushed and polished hand-finishing Multi-part sun-brushed dial with openwork and silicium explosion motif Edition size & Launch Limited edition of 18 pieces, 2018 Shipping Orders processed within 48 hours, EX weekends and public holidays.

watches.name: Celebration Skull
watches.description: Project background The skull is the ultimate symbol of life, death, and human experience — universally recognised and significant to horological history. CELEBRATION SKULL takes its cues from the Mexican celebration of Dia de Los Muertos and the emblematic watches from the Patek Philippe Museum’s historical collection. The result is a watch rich in symbolism and meaning. CELEBRATION SKULL reminds us of our own mortality while encouraging us to celebrate life. Technical details Dimensions: 57.4 x 41.3 mm (length x width), 10.9 mm thick Mechanical automatic watch Bespoke TT738 caliber with decorated skeleton bridges and hand-painted lacquer rotor Hand-polished stainless steel skull case Multi-layered hand-painted dial with lacquer and superluminova Date visible in the forehead of the skull Edition size & Launch Limited edition of 24 pieces, 2015 Shipping Orders processed within 48 hours, EX weekends and public holidays.
